name: Joint meson/dimuon calibration with primary and cascade production
normalization: per POT and epsilon^2; density normalized above chi-prime mass
omitted_uncertainties: Alternative virtuality descriptions, heavier vector fragmentation excitations, nuclear modifications, finite shower/source statistics and detector reconstruction

na50_calibration.scope: Common proton-initiated DY normalization at tungsten, and A exponent; no light-meson or bremsstrahlung parameters refitted.
na50_calibration.extrapolation: Normalization is continued to other dimuon masses and secondary proton energies; PDF/scale shape variations are retained. Pion and other non-proton initiated production is not normalized by proton data.
na50_calibration.covariance: 400: published target-specific errors, shared 3% luminosity and shared asymmetric extraction. 450: target statistics plus the bracketed common/independent systematic decomposition. Between energies, normalization nuisance parameters are independent.
na50_calibration.confidence: Delta chi2=1 profile intervals for the normalization, enveloped over the unresolved 450 GeV correlation and separate theory hypotheses.

origin_convention: point source at target front face
mass_coordinate: mediator pole mass; energy and angle describe chi-prime
